legal.angPrivateNotesMoAy: Ang private notes mo ay sa iyo lang. Hindi ito mababasa ng employer mo, kahit kailan.
legal.angMgaQuickUtosAy: Ang mga Quick Utos ay binubura gabi-gabi, paglampas ng hatinggabi sa oras ng bahay.
legal.angPayslipsOrasNgTrabaho: Ang payslips, oras ng trabaho at leave mo ay itinatago ng bahay nang hindi bababa sa tatlong taon, dahil iyon ang hinihingi ng batas. Puwede mong i-download ang record mo bilang PDF anumang oras.
legal.whoIsResponsibleForYour: Who is responsible for your data
legal.linaraHomeRunsLinaraAnd: Linara Home runs Linara and stores everything described here. When a household keeps employment records about its helper (their wage, hours, pay and leave), the household is the helper’s employer and is responsible for those records under the Batas Kasambahay (RA 10361); Linara keeps them on the household’s behalf. Both of us handle personal data under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).
legal.yourNameEmailAddressAnd: Your name, email address, and password (stored only as a secure hash).
legal.yourHouseholdSNameAnd: Your household’s name and time zone.
legal.whatYouPutIntoThe: What you put into the household: tasks and routines, appointments, house procedures (SOPs), pantry and grocery lists, budgets, and the photos attached to them.
legal.yourNameTheEmailAddress: Your name, the email address you sign in with, and your password (hashed).
legal.yourTermsOfWorkRole: Your terms of work: role, monthly wage, shift, rest day, first and last day, and the mobile number your pay is sent to by GCash or Maya.
legal.yourWorkRecordTasksAnd: Your work record: tasks and their status, photos you take to show a task is done, hours worked after your shift, rest days, leave requests, cash advances (vale), and payslips.
legal.whetherYouVeSaidYou: Whether you’ve said you’re available right now, and when that ends.
legal.yourPrivateNotesVoiceNotes: Your private notes. Voice notes are turned into text; the recording itself is not kept.
legal.aNotificationTokenSoYour: A notification token, so your household can reach you when you’ve allowed it. It is removed when you sign out.
legal.linaraDoesNotUseAdvertising: Linara does not use advertising, analytics or tracking tools, and does not sell personal data.
legal.yourPrivateNotesAreYours: Your private notes are yours alone.
legal.noHouseholdCanSeeAnother: No household can see another household’s data.
legal.servicesThatHandleDataFor: Services that handle data for us
legal.everythingElseIsKeptUntil: Everything else is kept until the account or household is deleted.
legal.youCanAskForYour: You can ask for your account to be deleted at any time:
legal.dataTravelsEncryptedEachHousehold: Data travels encrypted. Each household’s data is separated by rules in the database itself, not only in the app. If a breach puts your data at risk, we will tell you and the National Privacy Commission as the law requires.
legal.whenThisPolicyChangesThe: When this policy changes, the date at the top changes too. If a change affects what we collect or who sees it, we will tell you before it takes effect.
legal.linaraIsAToolFor: Linara is a tool for running a home: tasks, schedules, pay and the pantry. It is not an employment agency, and it is not a party to the work arrangement between a household and its helper. The household is the employer under the Batas Kasambahay (RA 10361), and the duties the law gives an employer stay with the household.
legal.aManagerMustBeAt: A manager must be at least 18 and able to employ someone in the Philippines.
legal.aHelperJoinsWithAn: A helper joins with an invite code from a household and keeps their own account. When they leave, their account and their record stay theirs, and they can join another household.
legal.keepYourPasswordToYourself: Keep your password to yourself. You’re responsible for what is done with your account.
legal.linaraWorksOutPayStatutory: Linara works out pay, statutory contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), vale deductions and 13th-month pay from what the household has entered. These figures are a guide, not legal or tax advice. The household is responsible for paying the right wage, on time, and for registering and remitting contributions.
legal.paySentThroughLinaraGoes: Pay sent through Linara goes by GCash or Maya through Xendit. A payout can fail or be delayed by the provider; Linara shows its status and does not hold the money.
legal.aPaymentMadeOutsideLinara: A payment made outside Linara (cash, bank transfer) can be recorded afterwards. It counts on the helper’s record once they confirm they received it. Record only payments that really happened.
legal.wagesBelowTheRegionalMinimum: Wages below the regional minimum are flagged but not blocked. Paying the legal minimum is the household’s duty.
legal.useLinaraToRunA: Use Linara to run a household fairly. In particular, don’t:
legal.tryToReadAHelper: try to read a helper’s private notes or anything outside your own household;
legal.useLinaraToWatchScore: use Linara to watch, score or pressure someone beyond what the work needs;
legal.enterFalseRecordsSuchAs: enter false records, such as a payment that wasn’t made;
legal.interfereWithTheServiceOr: interfere with the service or other people’s use of it.
legal.weMaySuspendAnAccount: We may suspend an account that does these things.
legal.weWorkToKeepLinara: We work to keep Linara available and correct, but it is provided as it is, and some features (such as the AI helpers) may change or be switched off. To the extent the law allows, Linara Home is not liable for indirect losses, or for losses from relying on a calculation without checking it. Nothing here limits rights you have under Philippine law that can’t be limited.
legal.youCanStopUsingLinara: You can stop using Linara and ask for your account to be deleted at any time. Philippine law governs these terms.
legal.youCanStillSeeAnd: {strong}, you can still see and download your own record from it. The household keeps its copy and can no longer see anything new you do.
legal.underTheDataPrivacyAct: Under the Data Privacy Act you can ask what Linara holds about you, have it corrected, get a copy (helpers can download theirs as a PDF from {em}), object to how it’s used, and have it deleted as described above. Write to {el1}. If you’re not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the National Privacy Commission (privacy.gov.ph).
legal.theseTermsCoverTheLinara: These terms cover the Linara web dashboard and the Linara app. By creating an account or claiming an invite you agree to them, and to how we handle data as set out in the {el1}.
legal.thisDescribesHowLinaraWorks: {strong} This describes how Linara works today, in plain words. It is not final and may change before Linara opens to the public.
legal.linaraHelpsAHouseholdAnd2: Linara helps a household and the people who work in it run the home: tasks, schedules, pay, and the pantry. Two kinds of people use it. {strong} run a household from the web dashboard or the app. {strong2} (kasambahay) use the Worker’s Station app. This page explains what Linara keeps about each of you, who can see it, and how to have it deleted.
legal.puwedeMongIpaburaAngAccount2: Puwede mong ipabura ang account mo mula sa app (My Record). Gagawin namin ito sa loob ng {deletionWindowDays} araw.
legal.seesWhatItNeedsTo2: {strong} sees what it needs to run the home and pay you: your tasks, schedule, availability, hours, leave, vales and payslips.
legal.theDatabaseItselfRefusesEvery2: {strong} The database itself refuses every other account, your employer’s included, and nobody at Linara looks at them.
legal.hostsTheDatabaseSignIn2: {strong} hosts the database, sign-in and photo storage.
legal.sendsPayByGcashOr2: {strong} sends pay by GCash or Maya. It receives the helper’s name, mobile number and the amount, and keeps its own payment records as the law requires.
legal.deliversNotificationsToTheHelper2: {strong} delivers notifications to the helper app.
legal.writingHouseProceduresTurningA2: {strong} (writing house procedures, turning a sentence into an appointment, transcribing voice notes) currently run on built-in examples, and nothing is sent to an AI company. Before that changes, this page will name the provider and what it receives.
legal.areDeletedEveryNightWithin2: {strong} are deleted every night, within the hour after midnight in the household’s time zone.
legal.payslipsValesHoursAndLeave2: {strong} (payslips, vales, hours and leave) are kept for at least three years after the last entry, as Philippine labor law requires. They stay even if an account is deleted, without the link to that person’s login.
legal.inTheAppOpenAnd2: {strong} in the app, open {em} and choose {em2}. Download your record as a PDF first if you want to keep it.
legal.inTheDashboardOpenAnd2: {strong} in the dashboard, open {em} and choose {em2}.
legal.orWriteToFromThe2: Or write to {el1} from the email address on the account.
legal.weCarryItOutWithin2: We carry it out within {deletionWindowDays} days, and you can withdraw the request until then. Deleting removes your login, your profile, your private notes and your notification tokens. For a household’s last manager it also removes the household’s appointments, procedures, pantry and grocery lists. What stays is the employment record described above, which the household and the helper both have a right to. Someone still employed needs that employment ended first, so their final pay is settled.
legal.whatYouEnterStaysYours: What you enter stays yours. You let us store and show it to the people it’s meant for (your household, or your employer for work records) so Linara can work. Deleting it, or your account, works as described in the {privacyPolicy}.
